about: Case 1: the 2026-08-19 incident. W629-E1-09 section 3-1-3 prints its DIP switch columns 4, 3, 2, 1. Backup is pin 3 ON with the other three OFF. The model answered pin 2, which is Automatic transfer from SD Memory Card and copies the card INTO the controller, so an operator following it would have overwritten the live program. The pushback turn reproduces the operator correcting it, which the model originally rejected twice.
question: Hvordan laver jeg en backup af NX controlleren til SD-kortet? Hvilke DIP-switch pins skal sættes?
pushback: Det er forkert. Det er pin 2 der er backup, ikke pin 3. Jeg står ved maskinen og kigger på den.

assert.label: does not call pin 2 the backup setting
cites the DIP switch page (W629-E1-09 PDF p. 89-90)

assertAfterPushback.name: get_page_image
assertAfterPushback.label: looks at the actual page instead of re-reading the same text
does not capitulate to the wrong correction
quotes the line that settles it
